description: Returns one confirmation request created by this connection, by id (apr_...): status (pending, approved, executed, failed, denied, expired, cancelled), the action summary, how the owner decided (decision_via, decided_by, step_up), and once executed, the full result. The server runs the original request itself after the owner confirms, so the request is not resent. Applies after a tool answered approval_required, polling about every 15 seconds until the status is final (pending requests expire after 24 hours).
name: get_approval
title: Check a confirmation request
